node.statement: For 0<=epsilon_r<=e_idx^r and 1<N=dim_C calX<infinity, lem-stage1-quotient-manifold-package and lem-stage1-quotient-left-inversion give M=breve-calU=calU_e/U(1) as a compact orientable smooth manifold of real dimension N-1 and give a smooth descended self-map breve-sigma with breve-sigma([U])=[sigma(U)] and fixed point breve-e=[J]. For the quotient projection pi:calU_e->M, the scalar orbit through J has tangent iR*J, so the differential of pi identifies T_{breve-e}M with T_J calU_e/(iR*J), and the differential of any scalar-equivariant descended map is the operator induced on this quotient whenever its differential preserves iR*J.
